candidateExplanation: Planner-derived after the 19-state cohort was prepared. The Revision-15 estimate of 309 included 30 incomplete tiles with no state at or above the 5% source threshold; the production runner cannot resolve soil states for those tiles, so the authoritative planner froze 279.

coverageBefore.coverageSemantics: GIS coverage counts tiles with real per-layer publication status; biological coverage is the pinned EPA profile maturity declared by the browser. A GIS-complete tile under an UNSUPPORTED profile is not finished national mushroom coverage.
